title: Authentication bypass via unescaped regex password comparison
description: authenticate() in app/server.js builds a RegExp directly out of the raw, unescaped `password` request field and uses `RegExp.test()` against the stored password instead of an exact string comparison. Submitting a regex metacharacter string (e.g. ".*") as the password matches any stored password, letting an attacker log in as any user without knowing their real password.
remediation_hint: Replace the RegExp-based comparison with a direct, exact string equality check (e.g. `record.password === password`), after confirming `password` is a string.
